title: GURPS Monster Hunters 1: Champions
label: GURPS Monster Hunters 1
notes: GCA cites this book as MH1:23; the system parsers from v1.1.0 (sargas79/GWorldVTT#138) read that with the plain prefix MH1. The data file has no templates, and PDF page = book page. The data file files each power's abilities under a prefix (BIO:, MYS:, ESP:, PK:, TEL:, TPN:) the book does not print, and under a category (_MH Mysticism, _MH Psionics - ESP) that powerCategory reads the power from. The six power modifiers are pp. 41-48 of the [MODIFIERS] section.
